name: Purple Thai
summary: **Purple Thai** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] and a cross of [[oaxacan-gold|Highland Oaxacan Gold]] and [[chocolate-thai|Chocolate Thai]], part of DJ Short's foundational lines. Some sources instead describe it as a pure [[thai|Thai]] landrace population stabilized by breeders such as Anesia Seeds. It was later used as a parent of [[blueberry|Blueberry]] and [[flo|Flo]].

sources.title: Flo (DJ Short)
sources.note: Describes Purple Thai as Highland Oaxacan Gold x Chocolate Thai in the DJ Short lineage.
